meta.name: bookmark-research-discovery
meta.description: Answer one question from a local Bookmark Canvas package: rank the cards it touches, read their links, search once for what they miss, and return a cited evidence bundle.

question.description: The user's question, in their own words

source_id.description: Indexed source to search; use index_status to find it

run_key.description: Unique local invocation key; keep it unchanged when the host resumes this run

max_steps.description: Reading rounds, from 1 to 6; the plugin owns the budget decision and stops the loop

output_language.description: Output language name or code, such as en or zh. Auto follows the question, with English as the fallback. Original quotations and identifiers are preserved.

bridge_path.description: Optional absolute path to hosts/shared/research-call.py when native MCP tools are unavailable
